Swan Agro brings decades of industrial engineering and manufacturing excellence to the agricultural implement sector. From primary tillage to post-harvest residue management, our equipment is built with Italian boron steel components, heavy-duty gearboxes, and precision laser alignment.

blocks.desc: Soil Health: Improved soil structure, root aeration, and moisture retention. Perfect clod breaking in single pass.

blocks.title: ROTO PUDDLER
blocks.desc: One-Step: Combines a rotary tiller and a puddler in a single pass for optimal wetland preparation and rice paddies.

blocks.title: SUPER SEEDER
blocks.desc: Single-Pass: Combines tilling, sowing, and mulching in one go. Directly handles paddy stubble without burning.

blocks.title: ZERO TILL SEED DRILL
blocks.desc: Tillage: Allows direct planting into untilled soil, eliminating plowing and conserving soil moisture & diesel.

blocks.title: MINI SERIES ROTAVATOR
blocks.desc: Orchard Prep: Breaks clods, combines multi-pass tillage tasks in one pass. Ideal for vineyards, orchards, and narrow rows.

blocks.title: MULCHER
blocks.desc: Soil Health: Chops/shreds residual crop residue into organic matter, enriching soil nutrients naturally.

blocks.title: POTATO DIGGER
blocks.desc: Efficient: Expeditious harvesting and easy use for customers with minimal tuber damage and high recovery rate.

blocks.title: NEW GENERATION POTATO PLANTER
blocks.desc: Efficiency: Increases efficiency, precision planting, uniform seed spacing, and drastically reduces labor costs.

blocks.title: INTER ROW WEEDER
blocks.desc: Weed Control: Effectively removes weeds between crop rows while preserving root zone integrity.

blocks.title: STRAW REAPER
blocks.desc: Function: Cuts, threshes, and cleans straw in a single operation, producing high quality livestock fodder.

blocks.title: LASER LAND LEVELLER
blocks.desc: Goal: Increases crop yield and precision water conservation by up to 35% with computerized laser guidance.

blocks.title: REVERSE FORWARD
blocks.desc: Tilling: Tills both forward and backwards for deep soil penetration and elimination of hard soil pans.
